text: 央行系统性比较近十年国际利率水平，中国贷款利率已相对较低 总体上存款利率低一些，贷款利率、信用债收益率高一些，货币市场利率、国债收益率居中。
text_en: PBOC systematically compares international interest rate levels over the past decade; China's loan rates are already relatively low. Overall, deposit rates are somewhat lower, loan rates and credit bond yields somewhat higher, and money market rates and government bond yields in the middle.
